lessons.title: Origins — Atlanta Before Trap Took Over

body.text: Goals: Teach ATL’s landscape pre–trap explosion. “What makes his voice pop compared to other rappers?” Teaches vocal timbre awareness.

body.label: Key points
items: Early ATL scene: OutKast, Goodie Mob, Eastside/Westside
Luda as a radio DJ (Chris Lova Lova) → understanding audience early
Fast recognition of his charisma & delivery

lessons.title: Word of Mouf — The Animated Animal

body.text: This the album that made Luda a superhero. Break down the cadence math in “Rollout.” Have him clap with the rhythm switches. It’s rap metronome practice.

body.label: Key points
items: The birth of “cartoon hyper-realism” in hip-hop delivery
Crisp diction + exaggerated vowels that make bars HIT
How humor became Luda’s secret weapon, not a gimmick
